tasks.title: Store the daily record and serve GET /api/v1/stats/history
steps: Create src/worker/stats/history.test.ts with the task's behaviours (the days answered, recorded_since and null days, invalid days, 401 and owner isolation, removal with the account) and confirm they fail; record events in them by writing counters through the new recorder directly until later tasks wire it into the routes

Add the next free migration (migrations/0018_daily_stats.sql unless another has taken it) with a table of one row per user and UTC day holding every counter and the six size columns (null until recorded), and a table of one row per user, day, purpose and model holding calls, input_tokens, output_tokens and calls_without_usage; both with a user_id column, so account deletion (src/worker/account/deletion.ts, which finds tables by their user_id column) removes them

Answer one entry per UTC day from days−1 ago to today, oldest first, filling days without a row with 0 counters, size null and ai []; recorded_since is the owner's earliest recorded day or null, and every counter before it is null
Declare the route and its 200, 400 and 401 answers in src/worker/api/openapi.ts
Document the route in docs/api.md and the daily record (what is counted, when, UTC days, never decreasing) in docs/architecture.md beside the statistics section

In src/worker/imports/imports.ts count each link importLines inserts into added in the same batch as the insert
In recordUse (src/worker/links/use.ts) add 1 to used, and 1 to restored when the link was expired before the use, in the same batch

In src/worker/decay/archive.ts count POST .../restore into restored, POST .../archive into archived and POST .../unarchive into unarchived, each conditioned on the update having changed the link, in the same batch
In deleteLink (src/worker/links/store.ts) add 1 to deleted in the batch, conditioned on the link existing before the delete
Count each event on the UTC day of the time stored with it
